ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DRIVE_RANGE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION check_drive_range RETURN NUMBER IS
 cursor cur1 is
 select skill_rating,nvl(min_proj_draw,0) min_draw,nvl(max_proj_draw,0) max_draw
 from valid_skills where job_code = :control_blk.job_cd and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id order
 by max_proj_draw asc;
 prev_min_draw valid_skills.min_proj_draw%type;
 prev_max_draw valid_skills.max_proj_draw%type;
 loop_ctr number:=0;
 mandatory_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
begin
 for z1 in cur1 loop
 loop_ctr := loop_ctr + 1;
 if (z1.min_draw > 0) then
 mandatory_flag := 'Y' ;
 end if;
 if((loop_ctr > 1) and (mandatory_flag = 'Y')) then
 if (z1.min_draw <> prev_max_draw + 1) then
 return 1;
 end if;
 end if;
 prev_min_draw := z1.min_draw;
 prev_max_draw := z1.max_draw;
 exit when cur1%notfound;
 end loop;
return 0;
end;
